Package com.velox.training

Class TrainingManagerBase

java.lang.Object
com.velox.sapio.commons.exemplar.context.ManagerBase
com.velox.training.TrainingManagerBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.velox.sapio.commons.exemplar.context.facet.ClientCallbackFacet, com.velox.sapio.commons.exemplar.context.facet.LoggerFacet
Direct Known Subclasses:
TrainingExperimentManager, TrainingManager
public abstract class TrainingManagerBase extends com.velox.sapio.commons.exemplar.context.ManagerBase
This class acts as a wrapper over ManagerBase that exposes additional managers and other utilities. Classes extending this essentially gain access to Exemplar context.
Since:
2019-01-22
